channel.title: Worship Connect Group — Resources
channel.description: Worship Connect Group helps churches build thriving worship ministries — vetted musician placement, team coaching, training through the Academy, and worship events.

item.title: How to Plan Christmas Worship Music (a Start-Early Timeline)
item.description: A month-by-month timeline for Christmas worship: decide the scope with your pastor, choose songs early, book extra players before they're gone, plan the candlelight service, and guard your team through a long season.

item.title: How to Make Worship Lyric Videos That Actually Look Good
item.description: Plan to the song, make the words readable, sync lyrics to the vocal, pick backgrounds that stay out of the way, choose the right tools, and handle licensing and export so your worship lyric videos look clean, not homemade.

item.title: Worship Lighting 101: Setting the Room Without the Rock Show
item.description: Lighting that supports worship instead of distracting from it. Light faces first, learn the four jobs light does, build a look per song mood, avoid the rock-show mistakes, and buy a starter rig in the right order.

item.title: Click Tracks and In-Ear Monitors: A Church's Getting-Started Guide
item.description: Why click and in-ears change everything for a worship band, budget setups from a couple hundred dollars to pro rigs, routing so the room never hears the click, and building a mix for every musician.

item.title: Ableton Live for Worship: A Beginner's Guide to Running Tracks
item.description: Why so many churches run Ableton for worship, how Session View works, the three tracks every set needs, routing so the room never hears the click, and how to play it live without fear.

item.title: ProPresenter Mastery: Running Worship Slides Without Mistakes
item.description: A pro slides workflow for ProPresenter 7: build the service as a playlist, use groups and arrangements, set one template, and hand the operator a real cue so the wrong-slide moment stops happening.

item.title: How Much Should You Pay a Worship Musician? (2026 Rates)
item.description: Real 2026 pay ranges for worship musicians, from salary data and per-service norms. What moves the number, how to budget for it, and how to pay musicians fairly without overspending your ministry.

item.title: Hiring Worship Musicians: The Complete Guide for Churches
item.description: Where to find worship musicians, how to vet them for skill and faith, what to pay, how to set clear agreements, and when a staffing partner beats doing it all yourself. The complete playbook for churches.

item.title: Beating Worship Team Burnout: Healthy Rotations That Actually Last
item.description: Why the faithful few burn out, and how to build a rotation that protects them. Set real boundaries, honor the time people give, and know when a paid fill-in is the healthiest call you can make.

item.title: How to Run a Worship Rehearsal That Doesn't Waste Everyone's Time
item.description: A tight, respectful rehearsal plan that starts before anyone arrives. Send the set early, expect home practice, run a timed agenda, do a full run-through, and protect one real moment of worship for your team.

item.title: How to Choose Worship Songs for Your Church: A Practical Framework
item.description: Stop picking songs by gut feel. A four-question framework for choosing worship music that is true, singable, tied to the message, and balanced between new and familiar, turned into a checklist you can run every week.

item.title: How to Build a Worship Team From Scratch: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: A calm, start-from-nothing roadmap for planting or rebuilding a worship team. Cast a clear picture, fill one seat well, recruit from your own pews, and run first rehearsals people come back to.
